result.brief: 提出SDI：以同一世界模型状态下actor自身序列的想象方差为参照，统一驱动探索信号与计划接受门控，在Meta-World、Adroit、DM-Control上提升任务表现。
result.reason: Uses world-model imagination for exploration and plan acceptance in embodied control; contribution is planning/exploration mechanism, not representation or world-model learning itself.
